scope: Persistent radio background across conversation, mission, guide and countdown; content committed in VBlank.
emulator: Genesis Plus GX; NTSC/PAL; A/B campaign routes
implementation: Mission uses a permanent background at tile 832 and a temporary content map committed in one VBlank.
Dialogue remains visible through WINDOW until mission content is ready.
Countdown loads while the mission remains visible and releases directly into gameplay.
Portrait transparency resolves to the identical existing brown without redrawing the background or modifying the original art resources.
